title: Share of US kids who walked or biked to school

source.name: National Household Travel Survey, school-travel comparison
source.publisher: Safe Routes to School National Partnership / FHWA NHTS

notes: NHTS-based analysis found that the share of US children ages 5-14 who usually walked or biked to school fell from about 48% in 1969 to 13% in 2009, the most recent year with a directly comparable national figure. Verified live via web search 2026-11-11.
